anchor: At level 3 my mage can copy two low-level blasting-school spells into their book for free. Which feature grants this and how does it grow later?
Whenever my wizard levels up to unlock a new spell-slot tier, can I learn a blasting spell of that tier for nothing?
Which sixth-level attack lets me zap a foe I can see, then jump electricity to three more creatures within 30 feet of it?
A caster's spell hits a foe for 10d8 electrical harm, or half that if the foe dodges quickly. Which spell is it?
Which divine path makes certain healing magic always ready at cleric level 3, adding a group-healing option at level 5?
My priest is level 7 and wants a ward against death plus a protective field always on hand. Which path grants those?
Which magic sack grows three mushroom-type creatures when a d100 roll lands between 41 and 50?
Which pouch of random wonders could give me a green-flamed campfire that burns a full day or until doused?
At what barbarian level do I get an edge on rolls to see who acts first in a fight?
I want to trick a foe's mind into seeing a fake creature I create, one that can hurt them each turn if they stand near it. Which second-level spell?
Which mind-illusion lasts up to a minute and vanishes once the victim figures out it's fake through a sharp-minded inspection?
Which fourth-level spell exiles a visible foe to a harmless pocket dimension, where a fiend or fey may never return if the effect lasts a full minute?
Mid-fight, I need one visible enemy removed for up to a minute with a roll it must pass; it can't act meanwhile. Which spell?
Which magic pole weapon can spend a charge for 2d10 life-draining harm, forcing a DC 15 roll to resist that weakens strength and constitution rolls for an hour?
Which rare, attunement-requiring item has three charges and gets back a random one to three each dawn?
Which everyday folk species earns a surge of luck after each long rest and gets one skill of their choice?
Picking a people for my hero, which option offers a feat of my choice and a size of medium or small?
Which gigantic chaotic evil creature breathes a 90-foot frost cone and walks over icy ground without making checks?
What giant scaled creature with a challenge rating of 20 can turn a failed roll to resist into a success four times daily?
At level 2, which barbarian option lets me swing with full strength on my first blow each turn, but gives foes an edge against me?
My barbarian is ready to swing hard and accept openings. Which feature trades defense for an edge on my Strength-based rolls until my next turn?
Which cleric power amplifies my voice to three times normal for a minute, granting edge on intimidation rolls?
Which cleric magic can slam a door shut across a room or gently shake the ground for a minute?
Which see-through ooze fills its entire space, holding one large or up to four medium creatures inside?
How hard is it to spot a glassy jelly-like monster that hasn't moved in front of me, and how much acid harm does its strike deal?
Which winged beast pairs a jaw attack with a stinger dealing 7d6 toxic harm and leaving the victim sickened until its next turn?
Which airborne foe has 127 hit points, a challenge rating of 6, and reaches 80 feet of flight per turn?
Which large flying creature can leave a foe's reach without provoking a reaction, and attacks twice per turn?
What large winged creature has 26 hit points, flies 60 feet, and walks 40 feet?
Which sixth-level mind spell makes a foe jig in place, giving disadvantage on its nimble-dodge rolls while foes get an edge on hitting it?
A foe that fails its Wisdom roll is stuck moving comically in one spot and can retry each turn using an action. Which spell is it?
What defensive gear grants resistance to arrow and crossbow damage but makes ranged strikes aimed at nearby allies hit me instead?
Once I attune to a hand-held defense, I'm cursed, and removing it doesn't help; only curse-lifting magic ends it. What item is it?
What garment lets me glide at 40 feet in dim light by holding its edges, and gives advantage on stealth checks?
Which wearable item lets me become a flying mammal in darkness while keeping my own mind, recharging at dawn?
Which seventh-level spell lets me drift into a grayish border realm, and returning into an occupied space shoves me and deals force harm equal to twice the distance?
Which 7th-tier magic can carry extra willing companions along, one more per higher slot level, if they stand within 10 feet?
Which fiend-blooded ancestry comes with a free minor magic trick at character creation?
Building a fiend-descended character, which of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma can power my free minor magic?
Which legendary creature can unleash a bug swarm at a creature within 120 feet, dealing 4d10 poison harm on a failed Dexterity roll?
Which creature can spend a bonus-turn option to inspire terror with a roar, or dash forward and slash once?
Which spell conjures ten magical fruits, each healing 1 point and feeding someone for a day?
I'm out of rations on a trek and want quick snacks that each restore a little health. Which spell provides them?
Which shape-shifting monster can read minds and frighten viewers with a disturbing face?
Which monster can turn into a medium or small humanoid form while its belongings stay unchanged, and sees without light out to 60 feet?
What jewelry piece makes me immune to a famous first-level spell that fires glowing darts?
Which uncommon worn item needing attunement halves pushing magical blasts?
My ranger has a target tagged as prey. How can I learn whether that creature resists or is hurt by certain damage?
At which ranger level do I gain a feature that reveals a tagged creature's weaknesses and resistances?
Which divination spell gives a vague good, bad, mixed, or neutral sign about a plan I'll do in the next half hour?
When a divination that asks for an otherworldly sign is repeated before a long rest, what chance is there of silence on each extra try?
Which creature reacts to a visible foe ending its movement within 120 feet by teleporting right beside it?
Which magic device's random table effect on a 51-55 roll enlarges the creature nearest my chosen point, redirecting to me if unaffected?
If the closest creature can't be made to grow by a random rod effect, who gets targeted instead?
At what fighter level does my champion land a big hit on rolls of 18 through 20 with weapons or bare-fist strikes?
Does the fighter's wider extra-hard-hit range at level 15 also cover punches without a weapon?
What worn piece lets me breathe underwater and swim at 60 feet per turn?
Which uncommon attuned mantle helps me explore the sea depths without air?
When a magic dwelling in a pocket of hidden space times out, where do the people still inside end up?
What handwear goes unnoticed while worn and adds +5 to my palming rolls?
I want a magic item that onlookers won't notice on me while I work the pickpocket trade. Which uncommon item is it?
As a ranger, which ability powers my magic, and can a druid's focus item serve me?
Every time I finish a full rest, can I swap one of my ready options for another? And how many ready options do I hold at level 5?
Which cantrip predicts tomorrow's weather at my location, or makes a flower bloom instantly?
What nature trick can light or snuff a candle or campfire, or conjure harmless leaves or animal sounds?
Which young good-aligned winged reptile breathes a 15-foot cone of fire and can breathe both air and water?
What creature's enfeebling exhale forces a Strength roll to resist, cutting my damage by 2 until I shake it off?
Which undead's claw can freeze a living foe in place for a turn, and whose stench sickens nearby creatures at the start of their turn?
What corpse-like creature shrugs off toxins and sickens foes starting their turn within 5 feet unless they pass a Constitution roll?
What tiny, swimming reptile hits for a little damage and adds 1d6 toxic harm on each strike?
Which small creature with five hit points and a swimming speed of 30 feet bites for 1d4 plus 2 damage?
If my headgear takes fire harm from a failed spell save and a d20 shows 1, its gems blast nearby creatures with light. What is the item?
Which gem-set item's blast reaches creatures within 60 feet and hurts those who fail a DC 17 Dexterity roll?
Which gem-set band gives protection from one harm type, with pearl for acid and jade for psychic?
If a d10 roll of 9 picks my protective accessory's damage type, what are the type and gemstone?
Which first-level divination lets me sense fey, fiends, undead, and several other creature kinds within 30 feet, blocked by thin lead?
Which paladin-favored sensing magic is stopped by a foot of stone or an inch of metal, and also notices consecrated ground?
